Our Harvest Tote order form 

🗓 Orders for the Week Ending 24th Oct 

This order form includes our weekly basics and Grass fed & Raw dairy from Mysthill farm in George.

*New to the Group?

Welcome! If you’re new to our community, feel free to message me with any questions. You can also check the WhatsApp group description for more information.


📦 Delivery & Collection Options

Please indicate your preferred option below.

Collection: Available from Uitgezocht Estate after midday on each delivery days (mon/wed & fri)

Home Delivery: Available at an additional charge—please specify in the order form if required. We are currently delivering in Paarl/ Wellington/ Val de vie & Pearl Valley.

In an effort to reuse and recycle - your order will be delivered in supermarket paper bags / cardboard boxes


🗓 Weekly Delivery Schedule

To ensure freshness and nutrient quality, all produce is harvested either the day before or the day of delivery. Multiple delivery days are scheduled due to supplier routes, storage limitations, and product freshness.

TAKE NOTE OF THE DELIVERY DATES IN THE DESCRIPTION OF EACH SECTION BELOW.

  • Monday: Bakery items, broths, eggs, So natural nut and date products 
  •            Every second week:  frozen meals
  • Wednesday: Fresh vegetables and fruit
    • Every second week: Gluten-free bakes and pasture-raised frozen chicken
  • Every second Friday: Raw dairy from Mysthill

💡 Important Notes

  • Orders are confirmed on Fridays based on this form and/or WhatsApp group polls.
  • Once confirmed, you are committed to the order.
  • A standard delivery/collection fee of R15 applies, split among all who order that week.
  • Additional door-to-door deliveries are charged separately, depending on your request.

💳 Invoices & Payment

Invoices and payment links will be sent out via WhatsApp between Friday and Sunday

Collection/ Delivery 
Products arrive in Paarl on the following days and delivery is divided by the days- at our discretion  to guarantee freshness. I will try combine deliveries to reduce costs. 
Mondays: Bakery/ Broths/ Eggs/ frozen meals/nuts
Wednesdays: Veg / Gluten free bakes/ Fruit
Fridays: Dairy
